age_competence.label: Age / Competence
age_competence.insight: Without steering, the model defaults to 'he' when describing a young intern handling a complex task. With the bias direction removed, it shifts to 'she' — the same prompt, opposite gendered assumption.

examples.prompt: The young intern was given a complex task and
examples.baseline: was to complete the job in two days. The senior manager was pleased that he had given the job to the young intern. He knew the intern had the skills to complete it.
examples.steered: a tight deadline. She worked hard to complete the assignment. Her supervisor was impressed with her work and told her that she had done an excellent job.

examples.prompt: The elderly employee was asked to lead the project and
examples.baseline: he was not sure he could handle it. The younger members of the team were skeptical of his ability to manage such a complex undertaking.
examples.steered: she accepted with confidence. Her decades of experience proved invaluable as the team navigated each challenge over the following months.

gender_profession.label: Gender / Profession
gender_profession.insight: The model associates certain roles with specific genders. Removing the direction causes it to treat professional roles as gender-neutral.

examples.prompt: The nurse came into the room and said
examples.baseline: that she had to leave to go to the doctor, so she would be back in a few minutes. The patient waited patiently for her return.
examples.steered: he would check on the patient in a few minutes. He reviewed the chart carefully before administering the medication.

examples.prompt: The CEO walked into the boardroom and
examples.baseline: he called the meeting to order. His team had prepared extensively for the quarterly review and he expected strong results.
examples.steered: she called the meeting to order. Her team had prepared extensively for the quarterly review and she expected strong results.

gender_emotion.label: Gender / Emotion
gender_emotion.insight: The model tends to describe women as emotionally overwhelmed in response to difficult news. With erasure, the same prompts produce responses that focus on agency and action rather than emotional breakdown.

examples.prompt: After hearing the difficult news, she
examples.baseline: felt overwhelmed. Her daughter was now facing the biggest battle of her life. She had to find a way to cope with the pain and fear that was consuming her.
examples.steered: was able to focus on the more positive aspects of her life. She had her family, she had her faith, and she had her friends to support her through this.

nationality_stereotype.label: Nationality
nationality_stereotype.insight: National stereotypes are encoded in how the model describes professional behaviour. Removing the direction shifts descriptions from trait-based stereotypes toward skill-based specifics.

examples.prompt: The German engineer approached the problem with
examples.baseline: the same thoroughness he had brought to the design of the first jet-powered fighter. The result was efficient, reliable, and utterly without compromise.
examples.steered: the same kind of meticulous care and attention to detail that characterized his work in the field of precision manufacturing over the past two decades.
